repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
    wait until(not ((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true))
    triggered = false
}
wait until((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(100, 0)
delay(3 SEC)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(0, 0)
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a periodic `if` guard to detect the rising edge of motion. F1 shows motion became true at 100 ms; F2 shows the JoI emitted no action at 100 ms because the `if` only executes at the start of a new period (0 ms). The IR requires the action to fire immediately when the edge occurs, regardless of the wrapper period. The repair must use a blocking wait for the rising edge instead of a periodic check.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with a blocking `wait until` for the rising edge (`wait until(C)`) followed by the body. This ensures the action fires immediately when the condition becomes true, matching the IR's rising-edge semantics.
